attr.title: Star Wars: Yoda Stories
attr.desc: A reimplementation of the 1997 LucasArts desktop toy. Every playthrough generates a new, always-solvable Star Wars adventure: explore a procedural world, solve item-chain puzzles, and fight your way to Yoda. Requires your own copy of the original game data file.
attr.inst: Requires your own legal copy of Star Wars: Yoda Stories. Copy yodesk.dta from it into the swyodastories/Yoda/ folder before launching.
